title: Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane
abstract: arXiv:2610.15062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations.

translated_title: 通过5G用户平面将AI推理作为电信网络API开放
translated_abstract: 将边缘人工智能推理作为网络服务来支持具有挑战性，因为当前的移动系统虽然能够传输张量，但无法暴露或理解赋予这些张量操作意义的推理上下文。先前的研究通过动态分区、协同推理和分割流水线来弥补这一差距；然而，这些解决方案仍然受限于应用程序、对网络无感知或缺乏上下文。本工作提出了按需推理，这是一种按需推理抽象，通过类CAMARA的应用程序编程接口（API）暴露分割推理，并在5G用户平面路径上以带内方式承载分割感知的张量上下文。我们在基于可编程用户平面功能（UPF）的测试平台上，使用可分区的视觉AI工作负载对IoD进行了评估，结果表明自适应分割选择可以作为面向网络的服务运行，同时避免了静态配置僵化的成本特征。
tldr: 提出“按需推理”抽象，通过类CAMARA的网络API在5G用户平面上暴露分割AI推理服务，并以带内方式携带分割感知的张量上下文，使自适应推理分割成为网络原生服务。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Inference on Demand" (IoD), an abstraction that exposes split AI inference as a CAMARA-like telco network API with in-band, split-aware tensor context over the 5G user plane, turning adaptive inference splitting into a network-native service.
